description: Serial checks against the AH-1S/F FY78 block 78-23046/23128; Aerial Visuals places the airframe at VFW Post 5560 Vernal and an independent photographer log dated 30 September 2014 records an AH-1F memorial at Vernal in fantastic condition with M197 cannon and TOW pylons alongside other US Army memorials; the serial itself rests on Aerial Visuals alone
